fm.title: Linear models
fm.description: Simulate imported LTI/second-order model objects (2 blocks)

rows.intent: Simulate an imported Control System Toolbox LTI model object (tf/ss/zpk) directly as a block — use to drop a designed or identified linear model into a model.
Simulate a large sparse second-order (mechanical/FE-style) model efficiently — use for high-order structural or mechanical dynamics without dense state-space.

fm.title: Linear parameter varying
fm.description: Gain-scheduled and time-varying linear elements for LPV/LTV modeling (18 blocks)

rows.intent: Discrete-time gain-scheduled two-degree-of-freedom PID whose gains vary with scheduling inputs — use for LPV control with separate setpoint and feedback weighting.
Discrete-time delay whose length varies at runtime from an input — use in gain-scheduled/LPV models with time-varying transport delay.
Discrete-time lowpass filter whose cutoff varies at runtime — use for adaptive filtering within a gain-scheduled design.
Discrete-time notch filter whose notch frequency varies at runtime — use to reject a time-varying tone in an LPV design.

rows.ref: cstblocks/Linear Parameter Varying/Discrete Varying Observer Form
rows.intent: Discrete-time observer-canonical state-space block with matrices supplied at runtime — use for LPV estimation/control in observer form.
Discrete-time gain-scheduled PID whose gains vary with scheduling inputs — use for LPV control of a discrete plant.

rows.ref: cstblocks/Linear Parameter Varying/Discrete Varying State Space
rows.intent: Discrete-time state-space block whose A/B/C/D matrices are supplied at runtime — use to implement LPV/LTV plants and controllers in discrete time.

rows.ref: cstblocks/Linear Parameter Varying/Discrete Varying Transfer Function
rows.intent: Discrete-time transfer function whose coefficients vary at runtime — use for LPV filtering or control in discrete time.
Simulate a linear parameter-varying model that interpolates among precomputed linearizations by a scheduling parameter — use to represent a nonlinear plant for gain-scheduled control design.
Simulate a linear time-varying model whose matrices change with time — use for trajectory-linearized dynamics.
Continuous-time gain-scheduled two-degree-of-freedom PID with runtime-varying gains — use for LPV control with separate setpoint and feedback weighting.
Continuous-time delay whose length varies at runtime — use in gain-scheduled/LPV models with time-varying transport delay.
Continuous-time lowpass filter whose cutoff varies at runtime — use for adaptive filtering within a gain-scheduled design.
Continuous-time notch filter whose notch frequency varies at runtime — use to reject a time-varying tone in an LPV design.
Continuous-time observer-canonical state-space block with matrices supplied at runtime — use for LPV estimation/control in observer form.
Continuous-time gain-scheduled PID with runtime-varying gains — use for LPV control of a continuous plant.
Continuous-time state-space block whose A/B/C/D matrices are supplied at runtime — use to implement LPV/LTV plants and controllers.
Continuous-time transfer function whose coefficients vary at runtime — use for LPV filtering or control.

fm.title: State estimation
fm.description: Kalman-family and particle filters for online state estimation (4 blocks)

rows.intent: Estimate states of a nonlinear system online by linearizing the dynamics about the current estimate — use for state/parameter estimation when the model is differentiable and only mildly nonlinear.
Optimal recursive state observer for a linear system with Gaussian noise — use for sensor fusion and state estimation when a linear model is adequate.
Estimate states of a highly nonlinear or non-Gaussian system using weighted sample particles — use when Kalman-family filters fail on multimodal or strongly nonlinear problems.
Estimate states of a nonlinear system using sigma-point sampling instead of linearization — use when EKF accuracy degrades from strong nonlinearity.
